methods: SHA-256 comparison across all 111 supplied files, all existing evidence catalogs and the previously linked timeline source
Rendered-page comparison for visually identical but byte-different PDFs, with metadata, creation-time, page-count and normalized OCR-text cross-checks
Page-by-page text extraction followed by OCR for every page without sufficient embedded text: 401 pages were OCR processed and 384 yielded text
Original-detail visual review of all eight pages left below the OCR confidence threshold, including divider sheets, a faint reverse-side form and large-format maps
Read-only Word rendering of the 41-page authoring copy to verify that it was the excluded Truth-First analytical report rather than a primary agency record
Revision-sensitive review: draft/final, versioned, corrected and differently scoped records were retained whenever their content or metadata was substantively distinct

Immutable GitHub preservation verification: the original 81 blobs were reread from commit b4705928d16ccaac9701ee43cba04369982c5ab6 and the three supplemental on-site inspections from commit 49922c706588f236e1edbad5fa8996e4c249e330, with recorded byte counts and SHA-256 hashes matched

MiEnviro repeat-intake verification: all 42 supplied PDFs (230 pages) were SHA-256 checked against every evidence catalog and the timeline source; the 41 unique content hashes totaling 200 unique pages were already preserved. The image-only three-page leachate-request source was also rendered and visually rechecked against its existing timeline copy.

decisions.name: Sixteen already indexed records
decisions.reason: Exact SHA-256 or complete rendered/text identity matched records already present in the Wexford, supplemental or timeline libraries. Existing catalog links were reused and no redundant copy was added.

decisions.name: Four 2019 county-minutes OCR copies
decisions.reason: The files labelled Duplicates_2019-03-20, Duplicates_2019-05-01, Duplicates_2019-05-15 and Duplicates_2019-07-03 render as the same pages as their official originals. Their only meaningful difference is an added OCR layer, so the originals were retained and the four copies were excluded.

decisions.name: 2025-05-08 Rule 215 portal pair
decisions.reason: Both three-page exports carry submission HQC-E6M3-FCV5K, version 1, and the same content. They differ only by a one-second MiEnviro generation timestamp and insignificant portal-render pixels. The earlier export was retained once.

decisions.name: Distinct revisions and similarly named records
decisions.reason: The flare report and revision 1, air-submission versions 1 and 2, 163-page and 165-page GCCS plans, and the two WDS screenshots were retained because comparison found substantive revision, scope or visible-tab differences.

decisions.name: Duplicate-like source labels
decisions.reason: Twelve retained records were proven distinct despite labels such as Duplicates_, ~2 or (1). Those misleading markers were removed from the app display names without altering the source files.

decisions.name: Truth-First Forensic Record Review
decisions.reason: The 44-page PDF and its 41-page Word authoring copy were excluded in accordance with the user's prior removal instruction. They are analytical derivatives, not primary agency evidence.

decisions.name: Other analytical derivatives and sidecars
decisions.reason: A key-pages extract, prepared history, compiled leachate collection, AFFF findings report, historical exhibit reprint, source index and JSON sidecar were used only for cross-checking and provenance; they were not published as primary evidence.

decisions.name: Source preservation
decisions.reason: The source folders were read only and were not renamed, moved or altered. The original 81 primary records remain at immutable GitHub commit b4705928d16ccaac9701ee43cba04369982c5ab6, and the three supplemental inspection records are preserved at commit 49922c706588f236e1edbad5fa8996e4c249e330.

decisions.name: 2014, 2015 and 2017 N3862 on-site inspections
decisions.reason: Each multi-page Air Quality Division inspection is distinct from the one-page full-compliance evaluation for the same date. All three were retained as landfill operations and regulatory context, not as PFAS sampling evidence.

decisions.name: Forty-two repeat Wexford/MiEnviro exports
decisions.reason: Every supplied PDF is byte-identical to an existing indexed or timeline source. The two portal exports named lagoon summary.pdf are also identical to each other, leaving 41 distinct hashes across 42 files. Existing clean display names and source links were reused; no duplicate copy or Duplicate label was added.
